# Test Runs

**Test Runs** are the execution records of scenario tests. Each run represents a batch of conversations generated by running one or more testers against a scenario.

## Viewing Test Runs

Navigate to **Testing → Test Runs**. The list shows:

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| **Scenario** | Name of the scenario that was executed. |
| **Testers** | Number of distinct testers used in the run. |
| **Conversations** | Total number of conversations generated. |
| **Status** | Current state of the run — see statuses below. |
| **Created** | When the run started (relative date). |

### Run Statuses

| Status | Badge Colour | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Queued** | Secondary (grey) | The run has been submitted but not yet started processing. |
| **In Progress** | Info (blue) | Conversations are being generated. |
| **Passed** | Success (green) | All conversations completed and all checks passed. |
| **Failed** | Error (red) | Some or all conversations failed validation checks. |
| **Cancelled** | Warning (yellow) | The run was manually cancelled. |

### Actions

| Action | When Available | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Open Details** | Always | Click the row to open the [Run Detail](#run-detail-view) view. |
| **Cancel** | Queued or In Progress | Stop a running test run immediately. |
| **Delete** | Terminal (Passed, Failed, Cancelled) | Permanently remove the run record. |
| **Refresh** | Always | Re-fetch the list from the server. |

## Run Detail View

Click any row in the Test Runs list to open the detail view. It shows:

### Header Bar

- **Run ID** — Unique identifier for the run.
- **Scenario name** — Which scenario was executed.
- **Conversations count**, **Testers count**, **Start time**.
- **Pass rate** — Percentage of checks that passed across all conversations (shown in green if 100%, yellow if partial, red if none).

### Tabs

#### Pass / Fail Tab

Checks for fields where an expected value is defined on the scenario's extraction or post-processing configuration.

- **Summary bar** — Overall pass percentage with total checks passed vs total checks performed.
- **Per-conversation breakdown table** — Each row is a conversation showing:
  - Tester name
  - Lifecycle status (In Progress, Completed, Failed)
  - One column per checked field with checkmark (passed) or X (failed) icons
  - Overall result column showing `X/Y` checks passed

#### Results Table Tab

A data table showing the raw extracted variable values for each conversation in the run. Columns include:

- **Tester** — Which tester persona generated the conversation.
- **Status** — Conversation lifecycle status.
- One column per **data extraction** variable (white background).
- One column per **post-processing** output variable (violet text, separated by a divider line).

Click **Export CSV** to download all results as a spreadsheet.

#### Conversations Tab

Lists all conversations generated in this run. Each row shows:

- Conversation number
- Tester name
- Status (using Monitor conversation statuses like Active, Completed, etc.)
- Last updated time
- **View transcript →** link that opens the full conversation in the [Monitor](../monitor/conversations) section

#### Explorer Tab

The [Analytics Explorer](../monitor/analytics#explorer) pre-filtered to this specific test run. Use it to slice and analyse run data by any available dimension or metric.

#### Funnels Tab

The [Analytics Funnels](../monitor/analytics#funnels) view scoped to this test run. Build funnels to visualise how conversations progress through key events within the run.

## Polling

While a test run is in progress, the detail view automatically polls the server every 5 seconds to update status and results. Polling stops once the run reaches a terminal state (Passed, Failed, or Cancelled).
